questions.question: The sum and product of the zeros of a quadratic polynomial are 0 and √5 respectively. The polynomial is:

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A quadratic polynomial is given by x^2 - (sum of zeros)x + (product of zeros). So, x^2 - (0)x + √5 = x^2 + √5.

hi.question: एक द्विघात बहुपद के शून्यकों का योग और गुणनफल क्रमशः 0 और √5 है। बहुपद है:

options.D: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

hi.explanation: एक द्विघात बहुपद x^2 - (शून्यकों का योग)x + (शून्यकों का गुणनफल) द्वारा दिया जाता है। इसलिए, x^2 - (0)x + √5 = x^2 + √5।

questions.question: For what value of k will the equations 3x + 4y = 2 and 9x + 12y = k represent coincident lines?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: For coincident lines, a1/a2 = b1/b2 = c1/c2. So, 3/9 = 4/12 = 2/k. 1/3 = 2/k => k = 6.

questions.explanation: Adding equations: 2x = 18 => x = 9. Substituting x=9 in x+y=14: 9+y=14 => y = 5.

questions.question: Which of the following is a quadratic equation?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Option A has √x (not a polynomial). Option B simplifies to x^2 + 1 = x^3 (cubic). Option C simplifies to x^4 + 1 = 5x^2 (degree 4).

questions.question: If the system of equations 2x + 3y = 7 and 2ax + (a+b)y = 28 has infinitely many solutions, then:

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: For infinite solutions: 2/2a = 3/(a+b) = 7/28. 1/a = 1/4 => a = 4. Also 3/(4+b) = 1/4 => 12 = 4 + b => b = 8. Thus b = 2a.

hi.question: यदि समीकरण निकाय 2x + 3y = 7 और 2ax + (a+b)y = 28 के अनंत समाधान हैं, तो:

options.D: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.question: If p and q are the roots of the equation x^2 - px + q = 0, then:

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Sum: p+q = p => q=0. Product: pq = q. If q=0, p can be anything. If q!=0, p=1. If p=1, 1+q=1 => q=0. Check options: if p=1, q=-2, sum is 1, product -2. Equation is x^2-x-2=0. Roots are 2, -1. Not matching p,q. Wait, p=1, q=-2 is standard result for x^2+px+q. Here p+q=p and pq=q => q=0 and p is any. Let's re-evaluate: p=1, q=-2 => x^2-x-2=0, roots 2, -1. p=1, q=-2.

hi.question: यदि p और q समीकरण x^2 - px + q = 0 के मूल हैं, तो:

options.D: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

hi.explanation: योग: p+q = p => q=0। गुणनफल: pq = q। यदि q=0, p कुछ भी हो सकता है। यदि q!=0, p=1।
